# Configuration reference

*Generated by `scripts/gen_config_reference.py`. Values tagged `[SOURCE]` are backed by a cited publication; `[ASSUMPTION]` values are project defaults to review with your mentor. `config/features/*.yaml` are merged automatically by `common/config.py::load_settings` under their own top-level keys. dbt reads its own copies in `dbt_project/dbt_project.yml` (kept in sync by a test).*

## `config/settings.yaml`

| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `local` | local \| full |
| `paths.sample_dir` | `data/sample` |  |
| `paths.processed_dir` | `data/processed` |  |
| `paths.duckdb_file` | `data/processed/atmosync.duckdb` |  |
| `paths.tableau_dir` | `tableau/data_sources` |  |
| `simulator.seed` | `42` |  |
| `simulator.end_ts` | `"2026-11-10T12:00:00Z"` | "now" for the sample run (fixed => reproducible) |
| `simulator.interval_minutes` | `15` |  |
| `simulator.avg_speed_kmph` | `70` | [ASSUMPTION] incl. stops/driver rest |
| `simulator.road_factor` | `1.25` | [ASSUMPTION] road km = great-circle km x factor |
| `simulator.setpoint_temp_c` | `7.0` | [SOURCE] WFLO manual: Hass stores best near 7.2C |
| `simulator.setpoint_rh_pct` | `90.0` | [SOURCE] WFLO 85-90% / Produce Blue Book 90-95% |
| `simulator.inject_faults` | `true` | duplicates, nulls, sentinel values for cleaning tests |
| `quality_model.base_shelf_life_days` | `21` | [SOURCE-based] WFLO: 2-4 weeks at optimum; midpoint used |
| `quality_model.reference_temp_c` | `7.0` | [SOURCE] WFLO |
| `quality_model.q10` | `2.5` | [SOURCE-range] UC ANR: deterioration 2-3x per +10C; midpoint |
| `quality_model.chill_floor_c` | `5.0` | below this, no extra shelf-life benefit is credited |
| `quality_model.rh_penalty_per_10pct` | `0.25` | [ASSUMPTION] extra rate per 10 RH-points below rh_min |
| `quality_model.max_gap_hours` | `1.0` | [ASSUMPTION] cap on time credited between two readings |
| `quality_model.recent_window_minutes` | `60` | [ASSUMPTION] window defining the "current" burn rate |
| `quality_model.required_retail_shelf_hours` | `72` | [ASSUMPTION] shelf life buyers expect on arrival |
| `quality_model.salvage_value_fraction` | `0.10` | [ASSUMPTION] residual value of unsellable fruit |
| `quality_model.rate_cap` | `4.0` | [ASSUMPTION] burn-rate multiple that maxes the score |
| `thresholds.temp_min_c` | `5.0` | [SOURCE] UC Davis: mature-green Hass 5-13C |
| `thresholds.temp_max_c` | `13.0` |  |
| `thresholds.rh_min_pct` | `85.0` | [SOURCE] WFLO 85-90 / Blue Book 90-95 -> union 85-95 |
| `thresholds.rh_max_pct` | `95.0` | [ASSUMPTION] upper bound (condensation risk, general UC Davis guidance) |
| `thresholds.valid_temp_range_c` | `[-30, 60]` | sensor plausibility limits (data validation only) |
| `thresholds.valid_rh_range_pct` | `[0, 100]` |  |
| `thresholds.valid_vibration_range_g` | `[0, 10]` |  |
| `risk.weights` | `{burn: 0.25, margin: 0.50, excursion: 0.15, consumed: 0.10}` | [ASSUMPTION] |
| `risk.slack_scale_hours` | `72` | [ASSUMPTION] |
| `risk.high_slack_hours` | `24` | [ASSUMPTION] |
| `risk.medium_score` | `30` | [ASSUMPTION] |
| `arbitrage.transport_usd_per_tonne_km` | `0.10` | [ASSUMPTION] reefer truck cost |
| `arbitrage.handling_usd_per_kg` | `0.03` | [ASSUMPTION] |
| `arbitrage.reroute_fixed_fee_usd` | `250` | [ASSUMPTION] |
| `arbitrage.min_benefit_usd` | `500` | [ASSUMPTION] ignore tiny gains |
| `arbitrage.min_benefit_pct` | `0.03` | [ASSUMPTION] of original-route net value |
| `alerts.enabled` | `true` |  |
| `alerts.dry_run` | `true` | set false + SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL / SMTP_* to send for real |
| `alerts.min_benefit_usd` | `500` |  |
| `kafka.bootstrap_servers` | `localhost:9092` |  |
| `kafka.topic` | `atmosync.sensor.events` |  |
| `kafka.dlq_topic` | `atmosync.sensor.events.dlq` |  |
| `kafka.consumer_group` | `atmosync-consumer` |  |

## `config/features/alerts.yaml`

| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `alert_center.risk` | `{warning_categories: [HIGH], critical_categories: [CRITICAL]}` | Phase 1 risk category |
| `alert_center.health` | `{warning_below: 60, critical_below: 40}` | health score (Feature 2) |
| `alert_center.anomaly` | `{lookback_hours: 12, warning_count: 5, critical_count: 3}` | warning = >=5 flagged readings; critical = >=3 CRITICAL readings |
| `alert_center.forecast` | `{scenario: trend, critical_within_hours: 12, warning_within_hours: 48}` | quality threshold crossing (Feature 3, heuristic) |
| `alert_center.arbitrage` | `{enabled: true}` | REROUTE opportunities raise a WARNING-level alert |
| `alert_center.default_actor` | `operator` |  |

## `config/features/anomaly.yaml`

| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `anomaly.temp_warn_min_c` | `null` | inherits thresholds.temp_min_c (5.0, UC Davis mature-green range) |
| `anomaly.temp_warn_max_c` | `null` | inherits thresholds.temp_max_c (13.0) |
| `anomaly.temp_critical_margin_c` | `3.0` | beyond the warn limit by this much => CRITICAL |
| `anomaly.rh_warn_min_pct` | `null` | inherits thresholds.rh_min_pct |
| `anomaly.rh_warn_max_pct` | `null` | inherits thresholds.rh_max_pct |
| `anomaly.rh_critical_margin_pct` | `10.0` |  |
| `anomaly.vibration_warn_g` | `0.6` | simulated vibration is lognormal (median ~0.25 g) |
| `anomaly.vibration_critical_g` | `1.0` |  |
| `anomaly.stat_window` | `12` |  |
| `anomaly.stat_min_periods` | `6` |  |
| `anomaly.z_warn` | `3.5` |  |
| `anomaly.z_critical` | `5.0` |  |
| `anomaly.min_std` | `{temperature_c: 0.2, humidity_pct: 0.8, vibration_g: 0.05}` | floors std so flat data does not explode z |
| `anomaly.roc_warn` | `{temperature_c: 3.0, humidity_pct: 25.0}` |  |
| `anomaly.roc_critical` | `{temperature_c: 6.0, humidity_pct: 45.0}` |  |
| `anomaly.gap_warn_minutes` | `45` |  |
| `anomaly.gap_critical_minutes` | `120` |  |
| `anomaly.stuck_window` | `8` |  |
| `anomaly.invalid_severity` | `WARNING` | severity for null / sentinel / non-numeric / implausible readings |

## `config/features/forecast.yaml`

| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `forecast.horizons_hours` | `[6, 12, 24, 48]` |  |
| `forecast.trend_window_hours` | `6` | readings used to fit the recent temperature / humidity trend |
| `forecast.min_trend_points` | `6` |  |
| `forecast.smoothing_points` | `4` | "current level" = mean of the last N readings |
| `forecast.trend_damping` | `0.5` | [ASSUMPTION] share of the fitted slope assumed to continue (trends rarely persist unchanged) |
| `forecast.temp_bounds_c` | `[0.0, 35.0]` | projections are clipped to this range |
| `forecast.rh_bounds_pct` | `[30.0, 100.0]` |  |
| `forecast.scenarios.hold` | `{use_trend: false, sigma: 0.0}` | conditions stay exactly as now |
| `forecast.scenarios.trend` | `{use_trend: true,  sigma: 0.0}` | recent (damped) trend continues |
| `forecast.scenarios.pessimistic` | `{use_trend: true,  sigma: 1.0}` | trend continues AND variability is one std-dev worse |

## `config/features/health.yaml`

| Key | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `health.window_hours` | `6` | trailing window of readings used for each score |
| `health.min_readings` | `4` | fewer readings in the window => no score |
| `health.weights` | `{temperature: 0.50, humidity: 0.30, vibration: 0.20}` |  |
| `health.temp_full_penalty_c` | `8.0` | mean deviation this far outside the temperature range => temperature sub-score 0 |
| `health.rh_full_penalty_pct` | `25.0` | same for humidity (outside the RH range) |
| `health.vibration_ok_g` | `0.6` | vibration up to here is penalty-free |
| `health.vibration_full_penalty_g` | `1.5` | vibration at/above this => vibration sub-score 0 |
| `health.classes` | `{healthy: 80, warning: 60, at_risk: 40}` | >= healthy: Healthy; >= warning: Warning; >= at_risk: At Risk; else Critical |
| `health.failure_floor` | `15` | any sub-score at or below this ... |
| `health.failure_cap` | `39` | ... caps the overall health at this value (=> 'Critical' with default classes) |

## Environment variables

`KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS`, `SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT|USER|PASSWORD|ROLE|WAREHOUSE|DATABASE|SCHEMA`, `SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`, `SMTP_HOST|PORT|USER|PASSWORD`, `ALERT_EMAIL_TO` (see `.env.example`); `ATMOSYNC_DUCKDB` overrides the local DuckDB file for dbt **and** for the Phase 2 app tables (`common/store.py`); `LOG_LEVEL`.
